children.content: The US President did not say how the money would be paid or where it would come from, but said it would be called the "Trump dividend".

items.title: $50 billion wiped off ASX in worst trading day since March

image.altText: White capital letters that say "ASX" on a dark blue background.

children.content: The Australian share market is having its worst session in six months, with $50 billion wiped off so far. It comes after Wall Street finished in the red and oil prices passed $US101 a barrel. Follow live.

items.title: Peter FitzSimons tells court Jones complainant was 'revolted' over claims

image.altText: Peter FitzSimons arrives at court for the Alan Jones trial.

children.content: Author and journalist Peter FitzSimons has begun to give evidence in Alan Jones's criminal trial, telling the court a young colleague of Mr Jones appeared "deeply upset" while detailing allegations of indecent assault.

items.title: Netanyahu denies being warned of Hamas attack 10 days before October 7

image.altText: A graphic image of Benjamin Netanyahu looking stern in front of a backdrop of newspapers and TV channels.

children.content: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu denies a newspaper report that he was warned more than a week before October 7, 2023, that Hamas was planning an imminent attack.
